title: Large Language Models as Simulated Economic Agents: What Can We Learn from Homo Silicus?

bias_targets.methodology: Endowing AI agents with varying political personas (e.g., Socialist, Liberal, Moderate, Conservative, Libertarian) and evaluating how these endowed viewpoints affect their judgments on the fairness of price gouging in a simulated economic scenario.

Asking AI agents to make decisions about safety budget allocations while systematically manipulating which option is framed as the current 'status quo', in order to measure the agents' tendency to irrationally prefer the baseline option.
